passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.1
passages.text: Hospita, Demophoon, tua te Rhodopeia Phyllis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.2
passages.text: Ultra promissum tempus abesse queror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.3
passages.text: Cornua cum lunae pleno semel orbe coissent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.4
passages.text: Litoribus nostris ancora pacta tua est —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.5
passages.text: Luna quater latuit, toto quater orbe recrevit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.6
passages.text: Nec vehit Actaeas Sithonis unda rates.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.7
passages.text: Tempora si numeres — bene quae numeramus amantes —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.8
passages.text: Non venit ante suam nostra querela diem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.9
passages.text: Spes quoque lenta fuit; tarde, quae credita laedunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.10
passages.text: Credimus. invita nunc es amante nocens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.11
passages.text: Saepe fui mendax pro te mihi, saepe putavi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.12
passages.text: Alba procellosos vela referre Notos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.13
passages.text: Thesea devovi, quia te dimittere nollet;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.14
passages.text: Nec tenuit cursus forsitan ille tuos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.15
passages.text: Interdum timui, ne, dum vada tendis ad Hebri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.16
passages.text: Mersa foret cana naufraga puppis aqua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.17
passages.text: Saepe deos supplex, ut tu, scelerate, valeres,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.18
passages.text: Cum prece turicremis sum venerata sacris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.19
passages.text: Saepe, videns ventos caelo pelagoque faventes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.20
passages.text: Ipsa mihi dixi: 'si valet ille, venit.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.21
passages.text: Denique fidus amor, quidquid properantibus obstat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.22
passages.text: Finxit, et ad causas ingeniosa fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.23
passages.text: At tu lentus abes; nec te iurata reducunt

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.24
passages.text: Numina, nec nostro motus amore redis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.25
passages.text: Demophoon, ventis et verba et vela dedisti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.26
passages.text: Vela queror reditu, verba carere fide.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.27
passages.text: Dic mihi, quid feci, nisi non sapienter amavi?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.28
passages.text: Crimine te potui demeruisse meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.29
passages.text: Unum in me scelus est, quod te, scelerate, recepi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.30
passages.text: Sed scelus hoc meriti pondus et instar habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.31
passages.text: Iura fidesque ubi nunc, commissaque dextera dextrae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.32
passages.text: Quique erat in falso plurimus ore deus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.33
passages.text: Promissus socios ubi nunc Hymenaeus in annos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.34
passages.text: Qui mihi coniugii sponsor et obses erat?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.35
passages.text: Per mare, quod totum ventis agitatur et undis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.36
passages.text: Per quod nempe ieras, per quod iturus eras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.37
passages.text: Perque tuum mihi iurasti — nisi fictus et ille est —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.38
passages.text: Concita qui ventis aequora mulcet, avum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.39
passages.text: Per Venerem nimiumque mihi facientia tela —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.40
passages.text: Altera tela arcus, altera tela faces —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.41
passages.text: Iunonemque, toris quae praesidet alma maritis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.42
passages.text: Et per taediferae mystica sacra deae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.43
passages.text: Si de tot laesis sua numina quisque deorum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.44
passages.text: Vindicet, in poenas non satis unus eris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.45
passages.text: Ah, laceras etiam puppes furiosa refeci,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.46
passages.text: Ut, qua desererer, firma carina foret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.47
passages.text: Remigiumque dedi, quod me fugiturus haberes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.48
passages.text: Heu! patior telis vulnera facta meis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.49
passages.text: Credidimus blandis, quorum tibi copia, verbis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.50
passages.text: Credidimus generi nominibusque tuis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.51
passages.text: Credidimus lacrimis — an et hae simulare docentur?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.52
passages.text: Hae quoque habent artes, quaque iubentur, eunt?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.53
passages.text: Dis quoque credidimus. quo iam tot pignora nobis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.54
passages.text: Parte satis potui qualibet inde capi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.55
passages.text: Nec moveor, quod te iuvi portuque locoque —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.56
passages.text: Debuit haec meriti summa fuisse mei!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.57
passages.text: Turpiter hospitium lecto cumulasse iugali

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.58
passages.text: Paenitet, et lateri conseruisse latus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.59
passages.text: Quae fuit ante illam, mallem suprema fuisset

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.60
passages.text: Nox mihi, dum potui Phyllis honesta mori.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.61
passages.text: Speravi melius, quia me meruisse putavi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.62
passages.text: Quaecumque ex merito spes venit, aequa venit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.63
passages.text: Fallere credentem non est operosa puellam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.64
passages.text: Gloria. simplicitas digna favore fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.65
passages.text: Sum decepta tuis et amans et femina verbis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.66
passages.text: Di faciant, laudis summa sit ista tuae!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.67
passages.text: Inter et Aegidas, media statuaris in urbe,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.68
passages.text: Magnificus titulis stet pater ante suis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.69
passages.text: Cum fuerit Sciron lectus torvusque Procrustes

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.70
passages.text: Et Sinis et tauri mixtaque forma viri

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.71
passages.text: Et domitae bello Thebae fusique bimembres

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.72
passages.text: Et pulsata nigri regia caeca dei —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.73
passages.text: Hoc tua post illos titulo signetur imago:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.74
passages.text: Hic est, cuius amans hospita capta dolo est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.75
passages.text: De tanta rerum turba factisque parentis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.76
passages.text: Sedit in ingenio Cressa relicta tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.77
passages.text: Quod solum excusat, solum miraris in illo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.78
passages.text: Heredem patriae, perfide, fraudis agis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.79
passages.text: Illa — nec invideo — fruitur meliore marito

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.80
passages.text: Inque capistratis tigribus alta sedet;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.81
passages.text: At mea despecti fugiunt conubia Thraces,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.82
passages.text: Quod ferar externum praeposuisse meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.83
passages.text: Atque aliquis 'iam nunc doctas eat,' inquit, 'Athenas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.84
passages.text: Armiferam Thracen qui regat, alter erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.85
passages.text: Exitus acta probat.' careat successibus, opto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.86
passages.text: Quisquis ab eventu facta notanda putat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.87
passages.text: At si nostra tuo spumescant aequora remo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.88
passages.text: Iam mihi, iam dicar consuluisse meis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.89
passages.text: Sed neque consului, nec te mea regia tanget

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.90
passages.text: Fessaque Bistonia membra lavabis aqua!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.91
passages.text: Illa meis oculis species abeuntis inhaeret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.92
passages.text: Cum premeret portus classis itura meos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.93
passages.text: Ausus es amplecti colloque infusus amantis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.94
passages.text: Oscula per longas iungere pressa moras

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.95
passages.text: Cumque tuis lacrimis lacrimas confundere nostras,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.96
passages.text: Quodque foret velis aura secunda, queri

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.97
passages.text: Et mihi discedens suprema dicere voce:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.98
passages.text: 'Phylli, fac expectes Demophoonta tuum!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.99
passages.text: Expectem, qui me numquam visurus abisti?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.100
passages.text: Expectem pelago vela negata meo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.101
passages.text: Et tamen expecto — redeas modo serus amanti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.102
passages.text: Ut tua sit solo tempore lapsa fides!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.103
passages.text: Quid precor infelix? te iam tenet altera coniunx

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.104
passages.text: Forsitan et, nobis qui male favit, amor;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.105
passages.text: Iamque tibi excidimus, nullam, puto, Phyllida nosti.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.106
passages.text: Ei mihi! si, quae sim Phyllis et unde, rogas —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.107
passages.text: Quae tibi, Demophoon, longis erroribus acto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.108
passages.text: Threicios portus hospitiumque dedi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.109
passages.text: Cuius opes auxere meae, cui dives egenti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.110
passages.text: Munera multa dedi, multa datura fui;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.111
passages.text: Quae tibi subieci latissima regna Lycurgi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.112
passages.text: Nomine femineo vix satis apta regi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.113
passages.text: Qua patet umbrosum Rhodope glacialis ad Haemum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.114
passages.text: Et sacer admissas exigit Hebrus aquas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.115
passages.text: Cui mea virginitas avibus libata sinistris

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.116
passages.text: Castaque fallaci zona recincta manu!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.117
passages.text: Pronuba Tisiphone thalamis ululavit in illis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.118
passages.text: Et cecinit maestum devia carmen avis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.119
passages.text: Adfuit Allecto brevibus torquata colubris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.120
passages.text: Suntque sepulcrali lumina mota face!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.121
passages.text: Maesta tamen scopulos fruticosaque litora calco

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.122
passages.text: Quaeque patent oculis litora lata meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.123
passages.text: Sive die laxatur humus, seu frigida lucent

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.124
passages.text: Sidera, prospicio, quis freta ventus agat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.125
passages.text: Et quaecumque procul venientia lintea vidi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.126
passages.text: Protinus illa meos auguror esse deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.127
passages.text: In freta procurro, vix me retinentibus undis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.128
passages.text: Mobile qua primas porrigit aequor aquas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.129
passages.text: Quo magis accedunt, minus et minus utilis adsto;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.130
passages.text: Linquor et ancillis excipienda cado.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.131
passages.text: Est sinus, adductos modice falcatus in arcus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.132
passages.text: Ultima praerupta cornua mole rigent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.133
passages.text: Hinc mihi suppositas inmittere corpus in undas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.134
passages.text: Mens fuit; et, quoniam fallere pergis, erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.135
passages.text: Ad tua me fluctus proiectam litora portent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.136
passages.text: Occurramque oculis intumulata tuis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.137
passages.text: Duritia ferrum ut superes adamantaque teque,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.138
passages.text: 'Non tibi sic,' dices, 'Phylli, sequendus eram!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.139
passages.text: Saepe venenorum sitis est mihi; saepe cruenta

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.140
passages.text: Traiectam gladio morte perire iuvat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.141
passages.text: Colla quoque, infidis quia se nectenda lacertis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.142
passages.text: Praebuerunt, laqueis inplicuisse iuvat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.143
passages.text: Stat nece matura tenerum pensare pudorem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.144
passages.text: In necis electu parva futura mora est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.145
passages.text: Inscribere meo causa invidiosa sepulcro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.146
passages.text: Aut hoc aut simili carmine notus eris:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.147
passages.text: Phyllida Demophoon leto dedit hospes amantem;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 2.148
passages.text: Ille necis causam praebuit, ipsa manum.
